name: 41018 · Erlanger, KY
findings: ZIP 41018 (Erlanger) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 41018 (Erlanger) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 41018 (Erlanger) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
